channel.title: News Today — Smart AI News Portal
channel.description: বাংলাদেশ, ভারত ও বিশ্বের সর্বশেষ খবর — স্বয়ংক্রিয়ভাবে আপডেটেড

item.title: কেন তৈরি হয়েছিল শুঁটকি মাছ
item.description: অতীতে হিমায়ন ব্যবস্থার অভাব এবং দেশের উষ্ণ ও আর্দ্র আবহাওয়ার কারণে মাছ দ্রুত নষ্ট হয়ে যেত। সংরক্ষণের এই সমস্যার সমাধান হিসেবেই মাছ শুকিয়ে শুঁটকি তৈরির প্রচলন শুরু হয়েছিল।

item.title: চা স্টলে রফিকের ভূত সংক্রান্ত মন্তব্য
item.description: সুকুমারের চায়ের দোকানে বসে রফিক জানায় সে ভূতকে ভয় পায় না এবং ভূত দেখলে তাকে চা খাওয়াবে। তার এই কথা শুনে মাসুদ অবাক হয়ে যায়।

item.title: বড় চ্যালেঞ্জের মুখে ম্যানচেস্টার সিটি
item.description: আর্থিক বিধিভঙ্গের অভিযোগে প্রিমিয়ার লিগ থেকে অবনমনের ঝুঁকিতে থাকা ম্যানচেস্টার সিটি দল এবার ইউরোপীয় প্রতিযোগিতায় পিএসজির মুখোমুখি হচ্ছে। ক্লাবের এমন কঠিন সময়ে সমর্থকদের মাঝে তীব্র উদ্বেগ তৈরি হয়েছে।

item.title: সূর্যালোকে ভিটামিন ডির উপস্থিতি নিয়ে বিভ্রান্তি
item.description: অনেকের ভুল ধারণা রয়েছে যে সূর্যের আলোয় সরাসরি ভিটামিন ডি থাকে। এমনকি কিছু পুষ্টিবিদ ও আয়ুর্বেদবিদ দাবি করেন যে সূর্যের আলোয় রাখা পানিতেও এই ভিটামিন মেলে, যা সঠিক নয়।

item.title: চলতি বছর মুক্তি পাচ্ছে না আলোচিত চার চলচ্চিত্র
item.description: শুটিং বা পোস্ট-প্রোডাকশনের কাজ শেষ না হওয়ায় 'সোলজার', 'আন্ধার', 'সুড়ঙ্গ ২' এবং 'খলনায়ক' সিনেমাগুলোর মুক্তি এ বছর আর হচ্ছে না। বছরের শেষভাগে এগুলো প্রেক্ষাগৃহে আসার কথা ছিল।

item.title: ১৪ অক্টোবর ২০২৬ সালের খেলাধুলার টেলিভিশন সূচি
item.description: আজ ভারত ও ওয়েস্ট ইন্ডিজের মধ্যকার চতুর্থ টি-টোয়েন্টি ম্যাচ অনুষ্ঠিত হবে। পাশাপাশি রাতে চ্যাম্পিয়নস লিগের খেলায় মুখোমুখি হবে ম্যানচেস্টার সিটি ও পিএসজি।

item.title: জর্জিয়ায় সিক্স ফ্লাগস রাইড থেকে পড়ে ব্যক্তির মৃত্যু
item.description: জর্জিয়ার একটি সিক্স ফ্লাগস থিম পার্কে রোলার কোস্টার থেকে ছিটকে পড়ে হাসান জিহাদ ইবন কারিম নামের এক ব্যক্তি সোমবার মারা গেছেন। পুলিশ এই মৃত্যুর বিষয়টি নিশ্চিত করেছে।

item.title: খুরা রোগ মোকাবেলায় নামিবিয়া এবং ইউরোপীয় ইউনিয়নের নিষেধাজ্ঞা
item.description: খুরা রোগ ছড়িয়ে পড়ার পর নামিবিয়ার কৃষকদের জীবিকা হুমকির মুখে পড়েছে এবং দেশটির মাংসের আমদানিতে নিষেধাজ্ঞা দিয়েছে ইউরোপীয় ইউনিয়ন। স্থানীয় প্রশাসন পরিস্থিতি নিয়ন্ত্রণে বিভিন্ন নিয়ন্ত্রণমূলক ব্যবস্থা নিয়েছে।

item.title: Gaza Strike and West Bank Assault Leave One Dead
item.description: Israeli strikes resulted in one fatality in Gaza and injured several journalists in the occupied West Bank. Meanwhile, roughly two-thirds of Gaza remains under Israeli control following a year-long ceasefire, as Prime Minister Netanyahu pledges dominance over the West Bank.

item.title: Jaishankar and Rubio Discuss Sanctions and Future Bilateral Summits
item.description: India's External Affairs Minister met with the U.S. Secretary of State to address worries concerning the sanctions legislation. Both officials additionally discussed preparations for upcoming discussions between Prime Minister Narendra Modi and President Donald Trump.

item.title: U.S. Secretary of State Rubio Schedules India Trip for Energy Discussions
item.description: U.S. Secretary of State Rubio will travel to Uzbekistan before heading to India for energy-focused talks next week. His itinerary in India includes stops in Mumbai and a planned visit to Jamnagar.

item.title: Microbiology Student Arrested at LAX for Alleged Poisoning in Wyoming
item.description: Authorities apprehended 32-year-old microbiology graduate student Aili Wang at Los Angeles International Airport while she allegedly attempted to escape to China. Prosecutors claim she laced a Wyoming colleague's tea over pending patent disputes.

item.title: Vatican Reports Pope Leo XIV Diagnosed with Lung Cancer
item.description: Pope Leo XIV successfully had a portion of his right lung excised to treat a malignant nodule. The Vatican confirmed that the scheduled surgical procedure proceeded without complications.

item.title: Delhi Police Detain CJP Members Saurav Das and Ashutosh Ranka
item.description: Law enforcement in Delhi registered a formal complaint and detained Saurav Das, Ashutosh Ranka, and other CJP representatives. The individuals face allegations of unauthorized entry into the Jantar Mantar zone.

item.title: Boat Capsizes in Bihar's Vaishali Resulting in Fatalities Among Minors
item.description: A vessel sinking in the Vaishali district of Bihar has left over a dozen children under 15 dead. Government leaders, including the Prime Minister and Chief Minister, have announced financial compensation.

item.title: Australian political updates on tax and resources
item.description: Treasurer Chalmers states that the ATO surcharge involved the prime minister, while a Nationals MP defends a controversial statement. Meanwhile, the Greens claim Australia misses significant resource revenue.

item.title: Vatican Reports Pope Leo Undergoes Lung Cancer Surgery
item.description: Pope Leo received a lung cancer diagnosis and underwent an operation to excise the lower portion of his right lung. The Vatican confirmed that the surgical procedure was successful.

item.title: The Rise of Podcasts as Influential Political Platforms
item.description: Recent developments highlight how audio podcasts have emerged as major political forces. Analysts examine whether these programs are transforming political engagement or simply evading traditional media accountability.

item.title: Seven Common Errors When Cultivating Curry Leaves in Containers
item.description: Growing curry leaves in potted plants requires avoiding seven major errors regarding soil preparation, sunlight exposure, and irrigation schedules. Proper care ensures the plant thrives and provides culinary and health advantages.

item.title: Owners Convert 1932 Timber Cabin Into Lucrative Holiday Rental
item.description: Marlon Sayer and Romolo Romeo purchased a dilapidated 1932 timber-cutter cabin in Bonogin and renovated it into a two-bedroom vacation rental generating $50,000 annually.

item.title: Music producer Lucian Piane dies at 46 after vehicle strike
item.description: Music producer Lucian Piane, recognized for his work on 'RuPaul's Drag Race', has died at the age of 46. He passed away from injuries sustained when he was hit by an automobile in Glendale, California, earlier in the week.

item.title: US Envoy to Greece steps down following misconduct claims
item.description: The United States Ambassador to Greece appointed by Trump has stepped down from the position. This departure follows accusations of inappropriate behavior.

item.title: Nani's 'The Paradise' outpaces Fahadh Faasil's film at box office
item.description: Nani's movie 'The Paradise' generated Rs 31 lakh on its 20th day, showing strong overall earnings. In comparison, the Fahadh Faasil project earned Rs 25 lakh on its seventh day.

item.title: Christopher Nolan's 'The Odyssey' heads to streaming in November
item.description: Christopher Nolan's cinematic adaptation of 'The Odyssey', starring Matt Damon and Anne Hathaway, is scheduled for digital and home video release on November 17. The movie previously earned over a billion dollars globally at the box office.

item.title: South Africa drops in WTC standings after Durban loss to Australia
item.description: South Africa fell to third in the ICC World Test Championship rankings following a 214-run defeat to Australia in Durban. Australia maintains its top position in the standings with nine victories out of eleven games.

item.title: UK home office data reveals rise in anti-Hindu hate offenses
item.description: Home office figures from the United Kingdom indicate a 15 percent rise in hate crimes targeting the Hindu community. The statistics highlight an upward trend in these reported incidents.

item.title: Houthi missile attacks target energy sites in Saudi Arabia
item.description: The Houthis and a Saudi-led coalition exchanged airstrikes directed at energy facilities. Falling debris from intercepted missiles in Riyadh resulted in four injuries.

item.title: Queensland defeats WA in One-Day Cup via Weibgen's century
item.description: Queensland defeated Western Australia in the One-Day Cup, aided by a century from former Australia Under-19 captain Weibgen. This marked his second One-Day hundred of the current season.

item.title: Saudi Aramco facility hit following coalition strikes on Houthi sites
item.description: A Saudi Aramco building in Dhahran sustained damage after the Saudi-led coalition launched military raids against Houthi-controlled infrastructure in Yemen.

item.title: Tamil Nadu scales up complimentary meal program for temple visitors
item.description: Ten designated temples in Tamil Nadu will now serve over five lakh worshippers annually. The expansion adds more than 2.25 million new beneficiaries each year.

item.title: Drishyam 3 reaches Rs 501.80 crore globally by day twelve
item.description: Starring Ajay Devgn, the movie surpassed the Rs 500 crore worldwide gross threshold on its twelfth day. Domestic net collections reached Rs 8.50 crore on October 13.

item.title: Tamil Nadu CM requests additional Krishna river water for Chennai
item.description: Andhra Pradesh Chief Minister Naidu made no immediate promise when asked for more water by his Tamil Nadu counterpart. Both leaders also talked about linking the Godavari and Cauvery rivers.

item.title: Delhi Police detain activists following security breach at Jantar Mantar
item.description: Legal representatives stated that Saurav Das and Ashutosh Ranka were taken into custody after a security incident. Authorities described the action as preventive detention.

item.title: OpenAI engineer arrested over hidden listening device in conference room
item.description: United States officials detained and prosecuted a Saudi national accused of placing a covert recording apparatus inside a meeting space.

item.title: BS-VII emission standards planned across three phases up to 2035
item.description: The implementation of BS-VII regulations is scheduled to take place in three distinct stages starting in April 2029 and concluding in April 2035.

item.title: Germany begins trial of Ukrainian suspect over Nord Stream blasts
item.description: Four years after the explosions, a court appearance has begun for Serhii K. He faces allegations of involvement in the destruction of Russian gas pipelines to Germany.

item.title: Fatal Georgia amusement park roller coaster accident leaves one dead
item.description: An individual lost their life and several others sustained injuries during a malfunction on an amusement park roller coaster located in Georgia, United States.

item.title: Treasurer Chalmers disputes interference claims regarding tax payment rules
item.description: Jim Chalmers addressed statements following the prime minister's intervention to postpone a debated prohibition on credit card transactions for tax authority payments.

item.title: Russian missile strike on Kyiv power facility kills two individuals
item.description: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky reported that an unannounced ballistic missile hit a power plant in Kyiv, resulting in two fatalities and approximately 20 injuries.

item.title: Missing woman's decomposed remains discovered at Chennai railway station
item.description: Police located the deceased 55-year-old woman at the elevated Mylapore MRTS station on Monday, four days after she was reported missing.

item.title: Former gang leader sentenced to decades in prison for Tupac Shakur killing
item.description: Duane 'Keffe D' Davis received a sentence of 40 years to life following a decades-long investigation into the 1996 shooting of rapper Tupac Shakur.

item.title: Author in Zimbabwe addresses online backlash over AI writing claims
item.description: Simbarashe Kundizeza publicly answered allegations that he utilized artificial intelligence to compose his recognized fiction work, which sparked significant social media debate.

item.title: Murugan's resignation offer fuels speculation of cabinet reorganization
item.description: A potential cabinet shakeup has generated discussion after Murugan submitted an offer to step down from his position.

item.title: Pope Leo XIV recovers from lung procedure following cancer diagnosis
item.description: Following a cancer diagnosis, Pope Leo XIV successfully underwent a surgical procedure on one of his lungs.

item.title: Hanuman Ansh Reaches Rs 337 Crore Total After Day 68 Earnings
item.description: Vishal Chaturvedi's movie Hanuman Ansh brought in Rs 1.30 crore net domestically on Tuesday. This figure represents an uptick compared to Monday, bringing the film's total domestic net earnings to over Rs 337 crore by its 68th day.

item.title: Flying Foxes Suffer Mass Hunger Across NSW and Victoria
item.description: Bat rescue groups are experiencing a sharp increase in emergency calls regarding vulnerable flying foxes. These animals, which depend on blossoms and tree nectar, are facing widespread starvation throughout New South Wales and Victoria.

item.title: Baththa Nears Rs 26 Crore While Sigma Lags Behind
item.description: Vijay Sethupathi's starring vehicle Baththa continues steady ticket sales, approaching a total net collection of Rs 26 crore. In contrast, the directorial debut Sigma trails significantly with only Rs 8.80 crore in earnings.

item.title: Smart TV Manufacturers Differ Widely in Software Update Durations
item.description: Purchasing an expensive television typically raises expectations for long-term device longevity. However, the duration of software maintenance provided differs significantly across various hardware makers.

item.title: Saudi Citizen Arrested for Concealing Listening Tool at OpenAI
item.description: The US Justice Department reported that a Saudi citizen was taken into custody on October 9. This followed the discovery of a recording device by OpenAI security personnel at their workplace late last month.

item.title: Science Corporation Tests Sight-Restoring Implant for Stargardt Disease
item.description: Science Corp co-founder Max Hodak announced that the firm successfully placed its vision-restoring chip into its first patient with Stargardt disease. The procedure advances the company's broader brain-computer interface development.

item.title: Assam BJP Organizes Statewide Demonstrations Against Congress and Rahul Gandhi
item.description: The Assam BJP staged statewide protests directed at Rahul Gandhi and the Congress party. Senior party figures, including state president Dilip Saikia and cabinet minister Jayanta Malla Baruah, participated in the youth-heavy rally.

item.title: Supreme Court Directs Senior Police Official to Attend Hearing Over Reporter Harassment
item.description: The Supreme Court has mandated the appearance of a high-ranking police officer. This action comes in connection with allegations involving the harassment of media workers.

item.title: Cerebras chief anticipates widespread household AI helpers
item.description: According to Cerebras leader Andrew Feldman, domestic artificial intelligence helpers will soon be standard in homes. These systems will utilize a mix of local hardware and remote servers.

item.title: Amit Shah accuses Rahul Gandhi of spreading falsehoods over SIR
item.description: Union Minister Amit Shah claims that Rahul Gandhi is fabricating information regarding SIR. Shah states these actions are intended to mask the electoral losses of the Congress party.

item.title: Martinez criticizes Manchester United management over spending
item.description: Following a 2-0 defeat to Atletico Madrid, Manchester United player Lisandro Martinez openly criticized club leadership. He expressed frustration regarding the organization's inadequate financial backing for the squad.

item.title: Olise receives rapid red card during Bayern's draw
item.description: Bayern Munich finished in a 3-3 tie with Viking during a UEFA Champions League match. During the game, Michael Olise was ejected after receiving two quick yellow cards in a matter of seconds.

item.title: Decline of Mini DisplayPort connectivity in modern hardware
item.description: The Mini DisplayPort interface was once widespread across various personal computers. Newer connection formats have largely replaced it, making the older port increasingly rare today.

item.title: Industrial Next aims to accelerate factory robot reconfiguration
item.description: Industrial Next develops technology enabling manufacturing robots to change functions in minutes rather than weeks. The firm assists factories in automating intricate manual procedures.

item.title: Saka delivers strong performance following Arteta's prompt
item.description: Bukayo Saka answered Mikel Arteta's call to action by entering the match as a substitute. His performance significantly altered the outcome of the Champions League fixture against Lille.

item.title: Ex-CEC Ashok Lavasa questions Election Commission's integrity
item.description: Former Chief Election Commissioner Ashok Lavasa has raised concerns about the ECI's trustworthiness. He highlighted widespread public worry regarding SIR and described the institutional reaction as troubling.
